newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Quaker Oats EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Quaker Oats EPS view up.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs anlaysts Nomi Ghez said Monday she raised her estimates for earnings from continuing operations, excluding charges, for Quaker Oats Co to $1.80 a share from $1.55 for 1997 and to $2.10 a share from $1.75 for 1998.
-- The higher estimates reflect the removal of operating losses from Snapple, which Quaker Oats has agreed to sell for $300 million, and reduced interest expenses.
-- Ghez said she had always been negative on the acquisition of Snapple, which posted operating losses for the two years since Quaker purchased it.
-- But she called Quaker's agreement to sell Snapple for $300 million, compared with its original acquisition cost of $1.8 billion, the "best solution" for right now.
